# jsPDF 2.5.2

This directory vendors the browser UMD build of [jsPDF](https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF) for same-origin use by Secure Tools.

- Package: `jspdf`
- Version: `2.5.2`
- Source artifact: npm package `jspdf@2.5.2`
- npm tarball SHA-1: `3c35bb1063ee3ad9428e6353852b0d685d1f923a`
- Runtime file: `jspdf.umd.min.js`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE.txt`

The file is kept unmodified from the published npm package. It is loaded from the Secure Tools origin and is not fetched from a CDN at runtime.
